data.gender_notes: Juliann is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Juliann is a female name derived from the Latin name Julian, which means 'downy-bearded'. The name Anna is derived from the Hebrew name Hannah, meaning 'grace'. The name Juliann is a combination of both names, symbolizing graceful and downy-bearded. The name Juliann carries the meaning “Julius + Anna” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Juliann usually hope their child will grow to embody julius + anna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
